executiveSummary: Open WebUI is a Python + Docker web application. There is no native/compiled code to port; ARM64 readiness is a matter of building the container for linux/arm64 and confirming native Python wheels resolve. Recommended path is a native ARM64 container build.
scoreInterpretation: The score is driven by the dependency and build dimensions. No architecture-specific source code was found, so the code dimension did not cap the score.

facts.statement: The repository ships a Dockerfile and targets container deployment.

alternatives.rationale: A native arm64 container build is straightforward, so a staged path is not needed for the core migration.

workItems.title: Add ARM64 build target to Dockerfile
workItems.objective: Ensure the container image builds for linux/arm64 by adding an explicit platform to the base image.
expectedOutputs: Unified diff adding --platform=linux/arm64 to the Dockerfile FROM line

workItems.title: Add ARM64 CI build job
workItems.objective: Add a CI job that builds the arm64 container so regressions are caught.
expectedOutputs: New GitHub Actions workflow building linux/arm64

acceptanceTests.description: Workflow contains an arm64 build job
acceptanceTests.expectedOutcome: CI runs docker buildx for linux/arm64

workItems.title: Add win-arm64 runtime identifier to the .NET project
workItems.objective: Ensure the .NET project can build and publish for Windows on Arm.
expectedOutputs: Diff enabling a Windows on Arm build for the project

workItems.title: Add ARM64 build configurations to the native project
workItems.objective: Ensure the native C++ project offers ARM64 Debug and Release configurations.

requiredApprovals.summary: Approve ARM64 build and CI changes
